description: Source code implementing LWM2M opaque resource read/write operations for Zephyr OS, including functions for getting and putting opaque data, and handling read/write operations.

methods.name: get_opaque
methods.description: Retrieves opaque data from a CoAP packet, handling block-wise transfer if necessary.

methods.name: put_opaque
methods.description: Appends opaque data to a CoAP packet for transmission.

methods.name: do_read_op_opaque
methods.description: Performs a read operation for an opaque resource, with access control based on resource level and version.

methods.name: do_write_op_opaque
methods.description: Handles write operation for an opaque resource, including object and resource validation.
